text: 11月3日，在2026中国香港国际金融领袖投资峰会上，金融监管总局副局长肖远企谈到以AI为代表的科技革命对金融的影响时表示，大家对这个题目有很多讨论，见仁见智。
text_en: On November 3, at the 2026 Hong Kong International Financial Leaders Investment Summit, Xiao Yuanqi, vice minister of the National Financial Regulatory Administration, said when discussing the impact of the technology revolution represented by AI on finance that there has been much discussion of this topic and opinions vary.
